thread:
Diego: hey all, Diego here. First day on Platform eng. Trying to spin up a tiny sandbox in asia-southeast1 but gcloud create fails with org policy. Also cannot see any billing accounts from gcloud: `gcloud beta billing accounts list` returns empty. Who should I ask to get a dev project + billing link + minimal IAM?

Ava-Cloud: welcome Diego :wave: We create onboarding sandboxes under ENG-Onboarding folder. Looks like your Okta role might not include the onboarding group. Can you confirm your GitHub id and desired project-id prefix? Also which APIs you need?

Diego: github is diego-m. project-id `diego-sbox-asia`. Need compute, storage, pubsub. No shared VPC.

Ava-Cloud: thanks. I'll open INF ticket to create the project but billing needs to be linked first. @finance-bot can you kick off the billing link to ENG-Playground?

finance-bot: Billing link request created: CL-9988. Requester: Diego. Billing account: ENG-Playground. Pending approval from Finance.

Ava-Cloud: INF-11999 created to provision `diego-sbox-asia`, enable APIs, and create SA `diego-dev-sa`. ETA ~3 hours after billing approved. Note: org policy blocks project creation via gcloud for non-admins.

infra-bot: INF-11999 assigned to Ava-Cloud. ETA 3h. Link: https://tickets.internal/INF-11999

Diego: thanks. Quick question: for AWS assume-role access, who do I ping? I may need the cross-account role for testing.

Ava-Cloud: ping @infra-bot will notify the SRE team; they manage the AWS role trust. Make sure you're in the `redwood-engineers` Okta group. If not, ask SRE to add you.

Diego: got it. Appreciate the fast help! :thumbsup:
